bear_assumptions: Normalized ADR EPS of USD10 at 25x as AI demand slows, overseas costs dilute margins, capital intensity weighs on returns and concentrated risks limit the multiple.
base_assumptions: Normalized ADR EPS of USD12.50 at 30x as leading-node and packaging demand stays strong but growth and margins normalize while the expanded capacity program earns adequate returns.
bull_assumptions: Normalized ADR EPS of USD15 at 33x as 2nm, AI and advanced-packaging demand persist, July momentum continues and global capacity execution protects margins.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower identity-matched price or stronger primary evidence produces positive confidence-adjusted expected return, clears the base-upside and payoff gates and restores the configured margin of safety; downgrade if leading-node share, yields, AI demand, margins, cash conversion, overseas returns or geopolitical conditions deteriorate.
